newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania rebel groups unite, demand Berisha resign.
newsitem.headline: Albania rebel groups unite, demand Berisha resign.

text.p: South Albania's rebel councils have united under an umbrella group, which immediately demanded that President Sali Berisha resign, d Xhvat Leeshi, an ex-army colonel and head of rebel-held Sarande, said on Wednesday.

He said numerous rebel councils from the town of Berat to the port of Sarande met on Tuesday and formed the National Committee for People's Salvation. It was not clear whether the port of Vlore, which has struck a separate deal with the authorities, was included in the group.
Leeshi said the National Committee for People's Salvation wanted a separate seat at all-party talks in Tirana which are trying to resolve the crisis in the Balkan country.

"We reiterated our demand for Berisha to resign. We want to be a separate body at the talks in Tirana," he told a news conference. The various rebel councils met in the southern town of Gjirokaster, he said.

An armed uprising has swept southern Albania over the past two weeks, with dozens of towns and villages being taken over by rebels opposing Berisha. The crisis was triggered when popular investments schemes collapsed in January, wiping out the savings of thousands of Albanians.
